title: NVMe controller command engine: one I/O submission / completion queue pair, Write, Read and Flush on a small namespace, completions with phase tag and status, a host memory master

fields.desc: enable; clearing it aborts the command in progress and zeroes the queue pointers once the memory reads owed have returned

regs.name: QBASE
regs.desc: Queue bases, dword addresses in host memory (change them only while CC.cc_en and CSTS.csts_rdy are 0)

regs.name: SQ_DB
regs.desc: Submission queue tail doorbell: writing it gives the new tail (0..7); a value of 8 or more, or a write while not ready, is ignored with ERR_DB

regs.name: CQ_DB
regs.desc: Completion queue head doorbell: writing it gives the new head (0..7); a value of 8 or more, or a write while not ready, is ignored with ERR_DB

fields.desc: SQ head: the next entry the controller fetches
CQ tail: where the next completion goes

irqs.name: ERR_CMD
irqs.desc: a completion with an error status was posted

irqs.name: ERR_DB
irqs.desc: an invalid doorbell write was ignored

notes: m_req_* and m_rsp_* are the host memory master (dword addresses); they pass through unchanged.
The core parameters QD (8 entries per queue), NBLK (8 blocks) and BLKDW (4 dwords per block) keep their defaults; the namespace is zero after reset.
